_why: ITEM 5 WANTS A PICTURE PER COMPONENT, 'rendered on a real frame at reference scale'. These twenty-seven are the ones Builder 2 ported. Every one is a frame of the SAME timeline at the SAME canvas on the SAME corpus fixture, so they are comparable to each other rather than each being its own demo — that is what reference scale buys. The frame was chosen per component from its OWN curves, at the moment its mechanism is legible, and is recorded here with the reason; a frame picked from the middle by habit showed Stack's furniture instead of its plate and is the reason that field exists.
_canvas: 1080x1920 @ 30fps; stills rendered by ChatCut cloud at 882x1568
_fit_note: The nine transitions render `contain` and letterbox like the base track; the four zooms render `cover` under the temporary exception, so a zoom still is full-bleed and a transition still carries bars. That difference is REAL and is visible in these pictures.

_the_nine: THE NINE ADDED 2026-09-21. Six text components and three zooms, placed on real gaps of the same th_lagos_en timeline and rendered by the same cloud path as the 18. Their copy is SAMPLED FROM THE FIXTURE'S OWN TRANSCRIPT — the words spoken under each placement — never invented. Every one carries a per-item `propertyOverrides`, which is the write field chatcut_job_app.py:1334 records as never found; it works, and inspect_item marks the values `(override)`.
_ported_mg: THE ported_mg REGISTRATION, started 2026-09-21. These are the components whose contract-shaped code already sits in chatcut_registry.json; the port work left is REGISTER + PLACE + FRAME, not a binding transform. Placed on track V3 of the same th_lagos_en timeline, copy sampled from the fixture's transcript.
_state_contract: DRAWS = a human-equivalent LOOK at the rendered frame, described. FILE_ONLY = a still exists with a sha but no recorded verdict — a file is not a verdict, and treating one as evidence is how an unproven component reaches a menu. Absence of a row is UNKNOWN, never BLANK.
